method: nvidia-modelopt v0.46.0 (snapshot 87c9f8cf) NVFP4 W4A4 on routed MoE experts only (E2M1, group 16, FP8 E4M3 block scales, FP32 global scales, dynamic activations); attention/shared experts/routers/embeddings/lm_head/vision/MTP BF16; PLE n-gram tables taken from the FP8 source revision; activations captured from live SGLang prefill (62,139 rows/layer)

methodology.eval_dataset: GSM8K full 1319 (temp 0.6, top-p 0.95, max 8192); AIME26 30 problems x 8 samples (temp 1.0, max 130k)

variants.name: NVFP4

headline_claims: single-turn accuracy preserved: GSM8K and AIME within BF16 range
long agentic generations tend to run longer than BF16
all integrity audits (structural, scale, unchanged-tensor byte equality) pass
